column1: # Kaishi 1.5k (https://github.com/donkuri/Kaishi), release v2.4.3: the Word field of its 1,500 cards, in deck order.
# The repository publishes no licence; only the headwords are used here, not the deck's sentences, translations, audio or images.
# key<TAB>headword. The key is SudachiDict core 20261015's normalized form (mode C) of the headword, as hanstat keys a book's words.
# A card Sudachi splits into an affix and one word is keyed by that word; a set phrase (お願いします) by each of its content words.
# Each key once (1,500 cards give 1,393 keys).
